changelog: **Scheduled reports screen** (`/admin/reports/subscriptions`, #1905 part 2). Admins with advanced analytics create a scheduled report for a team member or an outside address (report, cadence, weekday or day of month, UTC hour, language, e-mail table / CSV / Excel), send themselves a test, pause / resume, delete, and read each subscription's delivery history with the reason a delivery was skipped. Locked panel without the tier; the API's write-time refusals (unknown report, export add-on missing, foreign recipient) are shown in the form. Linked from the admin nav ("Scheduled reports") and from `/admin/analytics`. Covered by `e2e/report-subscriptions.spec.ts`.

en: Scheduled reports: send any report weekly, monthly or quarterly to someone on your team or to an outside stakeholder — a dean, a sponsor, a funder — in their language, as a table in the e-mail or as an Excel/CSV file. Recipients without an account can unsubscribe with one click.
tr: Zamanlanmış raporlar: herhangi bir raporu haftalık, aylık ya da üç aylık olarak ekibinizden birine veya dışarıdan bir paydaşa — dekan, sponsor, fon veren — kendi dilinde, e-postada tablo ya da Excel/CSV dosyası olarak gönderin. Hesabı olmayan alıcılar tek tıkla abonelikten çıkabilir.
de: Geplante Berichte: Senden Sie jeden Bericht wöchentlich, monatlich oder vierteljährlich an jemanden aus Ihrem Team oder an externe Beteiligte – Dekanat, Sponsor, Förderer – in deren Sprache, als Tabelle in der E-Mail oder als Excel-/CSV-Datei. Empfänger ohne Konto können sich mit einem Klick abmelden.

alt.en: The scheduled reports screen: a weekly compliance report to a team member and a monthly cohort comparison to a dean, with its delivery history open
alt.tr: Zamanlanmış raporlar ekranı: bir ekip üyesine haftalık uyum raporu ve bir dekana aylık grup karşılaştırması, gönderim geçmişi açık
alt.de: Die Seite „Geplante Berichte“: ein wöchentlicher Compliance-Bericht an ein Teammitglied und ein monatlicher Kohortenvergleich an ein Dekanat, mit geöffnetem Versandverlauf
